blocks.text: لما يحدث الآن: I am reading (أقرأ الآن). وللخطط القريبة: We are leaving tomorrow.
أفعال الحالة لا تأتي عادة بـ ‎-ing‎: know، like، want، need، believe.

sentences.t: My father isn't reading a book now.
What do you think you're doing?
We are going to the cinema.
I'm hungry, so I'm going to get something to eat.
sentences.ar: أنا جائع، لذلك سأذهب لتناول بعض الطعام.

sentences.t: I'm going to London this summer.
I am going to be a doctor.
We are going to travel abroad this summer.
Instead of going myself, I sent a letter.
sentences.ar: بعثت برسالة بدلاً من الذهاب بنفسي.

sentences.t: Instead of going myself, I sent a gift.
sentences.ar: بعثت بهدية عوضاً عن الذهاب بنفسي.

sentences.t: How is it going in the fish market?
I had to choose going with him or staying here alone.
sentences.ar: عليّ أن أختار بين الذهاب معه أو البقاء هنا وحدي.

sentences.t: I believe he is going to be rich one day.
sentences.ar: أعتقد أنه سيصبح غنياً يوماً ما.

sentences.t: Hi, Mimi! How are you doing?
I was reading a novel then.

sentences.ar: نظرياً ، ما أقوم به متعلق بالرياضيات.
إلى أين أنت ذاهبٌ يا أبي؟

sentences.t: This is never going to end.
Which city are you going to visit first?
Are you going to buy the car?
